pepita.bio: Pepita tends the floristería with marigold crowns and braids full of petals. She skips when she thinks nobody is watching.
pepita.likes: Fresh marigolds, arranging bouquets, waving at visitors

abuela_rosa.bio: Abuela Rosa remembers every ofrenda and every name on the wind. She moves slowly but never misses a candle.
abuela_rosa.likes: Quiet benches, marigold paths, telling stories at dusk

xolo.bio: Xolo guards the plaza stoop and claims any pan dulce within nose range. Faithful, bouncy, always hungry.
xolo.likes: Pan dulce, chasing treats, napping in sun patches

gato.bio: Gato pretends to be above festival fuss but always appears when music plays. Expert at looking unimpressed.
gato.likes: Warm bakery steps, judging passersby, secret naps

tito.bio: Tito lives for the stage guitar hook. Give him music and the whole plaza finds its rhythm.
tito.likes: The mariachi stage, encore nights, dancing crowds

miguel.bio: Miguel runs errands between stalls with a grin and a basket. Always headed somewhere with purpose.
miguel.likes: Mercado finds, helping Pepita, festival gossip

dona_luz.bio: Doña Luz tends the church steps and keeps the candle path lit. Her quiet presence settles the plaza.
dona_luz.likes: Lighting candles, peaceful sits, night vigils

alebrije.bio: Alebrije drifts between worlds with impossible colors. Children swear it winks when fireworks are near.

chavo.bio: Chavo carries pan dulce warm from the oven and knows every shortcut across the cobble.
chavo.likes: Panadería smells, racing Xolo, sweet samples

don_mateo.bio: Don Mateo watches the mercado stalls with a trader's eye and a storyteller's pause.
don_mateo.likes: Sugar skull displays, fair deals, afternoon shade

pinto.bio: Pinto helps Pepita when the festival rush hits. Quick feet, faster jokes.
pinto.likes: Flower buckets, plaza crossings, mariachi nights

senor_cuervo.bio: Señor Cuervo perches near the mercado with a knowing caw. Nothing slips past him.
senor_cuervo.likes: High vantage points, shiny trinkets, dramatic entrances
